summary: Controlled interface for privacy and cookie preferences.
whenToUse: Present consent categories and choices via PrivacyPreferences.

props.name: title
props.description: Title and accessible name of the section.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Callback to the consumer when the user confirms.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Message shown when the callback fails.

keyboard.action: Navigates and edits the PrivacyPreferences categories and buttons.

accessibility: The section is associated with its own title and composes already accessible controls.
responsive: Categories and actions adapt to narrow containers.
customization: PrivacyPreferences keeps checkboxes and actions consistent; styles use --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: No consent is saved here: the consumer handles policy and persistence.
limits: The onSave callback belongs to the consumer.
